scope: Matched clean BLTE and RQ1 only; not BLTE journal ablation/strict/sensitivity or RQ1 journal 230-run suite.
auc_definition: Per-class one-vs-rest ROC-AUC with tie half-credit; macro is unweighted mean of three classes; weighted uses test support.
ap_definition: Non-interpolated average precision, grouped thresholds; not trapezoidal PR-AUC.
summary_definition: Mean and sample SD across ten seeds, not pooled predictions.
